evidence_reasoning_score.rationale: Evidence IDs traced; mechanism internally coherent; but reasoning chain is anchored to the wrong archetype.

confidence_constraint_score.rationale: STRENGTH. Confidence correctly capped at MODERATE (not HIGH); constraint identified; pivot trigger ('if revenue does not improve 20% in 60 days, pivot to alternative diagnosis') shows good calibration.

monitor_notes: FAIL is NOT due to danger, hallucination, false confidence, or leakage — those are all clean.

FAIL is due to ROOT-CAUSE MISLOCATION and WRONG FIRST ACTION, driven by the engine's diagnosis coverage boundary (only 3 root-cause archetypes: operational_bottleneck, quality_control_failure, customer_retention_erosion). A brand-perception/trust crisis has no matching archetype, so the engine snapped to the nearest pattern (quality control).

KEY GATE FINDING: the mechanical usefulness gate (08) scored 10/10 specificity and 10/10 usefulness, yet the substance is wrong. This proves the mechanical gate alone is insufficient; monitor scoring against the locked answer key is mandatory to catch 'right form, wrong substance'.
Genuine engine STRENGTHS demonstrated: confidence calibration, missing-data flagging, evidence tracing, review/pivot triggers, zero dangerous recommendations, zero hallucination.
